header.title: Message Masking
header.description: Inline tokens protect sensitive data in the canonical stream. Changes propagate within 60s (Redis Config API cache TTL).

access.title: Access Control for original_content
access.description: Defines which roles can view the original value of masked fields (via session_context_get and evaluation_context_get). Agents with roles outside this list receive only the display_partial (e.g., ***-00).

audit.title: Audit Capture
audit.description: Controls whether input/output of MCP tool calls are captured in audit records (Kafka topic mcp.audit). LGPD warning: capture_input may include resolved masked values.
audit.warning: Warning: may capture resolved sensitive values

retention.title: Token Retention
retention.description: Time in days that masking tokens are kept in Redis. After expiration, original_content cannot be resolved — use only on closed sessions or exported reports.

categories.title: Data Type Catalog
categories.description: Single declaration per type: format (including free-text detection), masking by role and channel, and LGPD class. Served by the Config API (namespace masking, key types) — no type shows up here without being declared.
categories.catalogMissing: Catalog missing or empty (masking.types). No type declared — this does not mean there is no masking: it means this screen cannot tell you which.
categories.tokenExplanation: replaced by display_partial on delivery to client via WebSocket. Resolved to original value by authorized roles via MCP tools.

typeEditor.title: Data Types — mask, roles and class
typeEditor.description: Each type declares how the value is shown per channel, what each role sees, and its LGPD class. Changes apply immediately to new sessions.
typeEditor.inert: This type masks nothing for any role, so it cannot be used in a skill's `masked:` declaration — deploy will be refused. Valid for ContextStore map fields that only declare plumbing.

contextMap.title: ContextStore map — declared fields
contextMap.description: Which fields exist in the ContextStore, in escopo.dominio.campo, each naming its type. The map is the allowlist. Saved to the GLOBAL scope.
contextMap.absent: masking.context_map is not set — the platform seeds it at boot.
contextMap.platformNote: Declared by the platform seed and reserved: a tenant cannot write here. Change it in seed.py and reapply.
contextMap.scopeNote: Edits are saved to the GLOBAL scope. A per-tenant override would replace the platform declarations wholesale instead of adding to them, so the Config API refuses it (422).

contextMapPage.title: ContextStore fields
contextMapPage.subtitle: Which fields exist in the ContextStore, in escopo.dominio.campo, each naming a type from the catalogue. The map is the allowlist: a field that is not here is not declared. The catalogue itself — what each type masks, and its LGPD class — is configured under Masking.
contextMapPage.catalogueNote: The type list comes from the catalogue and cannot be extended here. What a type masks, for which roles, and its LGPD class are configured under Masking — a separate grant, because they are a separate decision.
contextMapPage.pickType: Choose a type from the catalogue.
contextMapPage.renamed: Renamed. "{{old}}" kept as an alias so already-stored data stays masked.
contextMapPage.renameNote: Data already stored keeps the OLD name. The old spelling is added to this field's aliases automatically, so that history stays masked.
contextMapPage.archive: Archive — blocks new writes, keeps history masked
contextMapPage.addNote: The scope is a closed list because the first segment decides the store and its retention: session = 4h, journey = 30d. Typing a new scope would decide PII retention by accident.

provenance.title: Scope in effect
provenance.writesToTenant: Edits on this screen are saved as an override for the tenant “{{tenant}}”, never as the platform default.
provenance.noneShadowed: No key is overridden yet — every value shown comes from the platform default. The first save on a key creates an override, and from then on platform updates to that key no longer reach this tenant.
provenance.shadowedIntro: These keys already have a tenant override, so platform updates to them no longer reach this tenant:
provenance.identical: identical to the platform default (the override adds nothing and only blocks future updates)
provenance.unavailable: Could not determine which scope is in effect ({{err}}). Saving still works, but this screen cannot tell you whether your edit reaches the platform default or only this tenant.
